decisions.reason: As a multi-model flagship line tied publicly to the firm's lower-carbon building-climate strategy, the added year of commitment and investment makes management very likely to continue backing it.

Although less central than the flagship lines, it still extends the firm's infrared offering and in a growing firm with broad product range management is more likely to justify continued support than to withdraw it quickly.

This multi-model industrial hall heater fits closely with the core customer base and installed-systems logic, so accumulated development effort and plausible temporary explanations for any weak uptake favor retention.
Because this hydrogen-capable line is a highly visible strategic commitment linked to the firm's announced future direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
